description: Book a charter with a captain. A captain with Instant Book on returns a Stripe Checkout link (payment.kind checkout_link) for the charterer to complete payment. A captain who reviews every request first (get_quote's instantBook: false) is sent a request instead: nothing is charged, the result is a request with the estimated total and deposit, and if the captain accepts, the charterer is emailed a link to pay. Optionally attach a partner/affiliate code to credit a referrer; partnerCode can't be used on a request (PARTNER_CODE_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_REQUESTS). harborId must be a harbor this captain departs from: one of get_captain's harbors, or any list_harbors harbor when get_captain lists none. create_booking refuses any other harbor with HARBOR_NOT_OFFERED, and that error's harbors field lists the ones the captain departs from.
name: create_booking
title: Create Booking
